models_evaluated: 14 open-source and proprietary LLMs (not named in the text)

links.outcome: LLM procedure extraction accuracy versus administrator-assigned coding labels, on the same notes
links.effect: LLMs consistently outperformed administrator-assigned labels, with macro-F1 above 0.6 and up to 10 points of improvement over administrative coding.
links.quote: We find that across models, LLMs consistently outperform administrator-assigned labels, achieving macro-F1 scores above 0.6 and improving over administrative coding by up to 10 points.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM performance across model scale, reasoning capability and prompt design
Stratifying LLM extraction performance by procedure frequency

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing 14 open-source and proprietary LLMs for zero-shot procedure code extraction from 800 retrospective orthopedic operative notes compared to human annotators.
